title: A session that writes an allow rule to settings.local.json is asked whether it belongs in the shared settings.json
why:
Owner asks whether sessions add permission allowances to local settings when they should be global. 23:12 CST Nov 14 REST read, status unchanged: #3323 (merged 22:42 CST Nov 13) is the Session Installer allow entry, a different step, not this one. This step's PR #3343 (the guard that asks on a local allow rule) is open, draft, last update 00:53 CST Nov 14; #3386 (notes of open findings) is open. The move of the three cloud-only merge allows is not in a merged PR. Triage 00:12 CST (GitHub REST read): #3343 (the ask guard) is an open draft, head 862dd572a070, updated 06:53Z (00:53 CST Nov 14), not merged; #3386 (its notes) is an open draft, updated 07:07Z. Not landed.

[00:16 CST Nov 16, triage] Full note before the trim to 200 words (goal item 6, option b):
Filed 20:17 CST Nov 13. Owner 20:16 CST Nov 13 (relayed): sessions may add allowances locally that should be global. Unmeasured: how often it happens. Fix: when a session writes an allow rule to settings.local.json, a guard asks whether it belongs in the shared settings.json and routes it to a lane PR. A guard; the lane measures first (read settings.local.json files that are readable), then test-author red case, builder, reviewer. Needs a lane. Lane started 20:18 CST Nov 13 (coordinator): session_013NEJL2mJoAeFDsLisvHPEE (Sonnet, medium; searches open PRs for a duplicate first). OWNER-FLAGGED VERY IMPORTANT, owner 20:19 CST Nov 13 (relayed by the consultant 20:24; triage did not see the chat): "triage/u/coordinator/batch runner shd also check if they have unique allows that r local and ought to be global (local-allow-goes-global) v important". Each standing session reads its settings.local.json files and lists entries the shared settings.json lacks, with a pick per entry (global, keep local with a reason, or drop); change nothing yet. Reads so far: triage (this session) found no settings.local.json anywhere it can see (~/.claude, claude-settings, its worktree, joyous, ios-adblock); three allow entries in the installed ~/.claude/settings.json are not in the shared settings.json (merge * --confirm, merge * --confirm *, merge --role batch-runner), and all three come from the shared merge/cloud_allow.json, so they are not local. Coordinator: no settings.local.json in its session (20:20). Owner ruling 20:29 CST Nov 13 (via the consultant, 20:28): local sessions get everything cloud sessions get (ruling own-local-autonomy-like-cloud, step local-autonomy-equals-cloud). The three cloud-only merge allows (merge/cloud_allow.json) are therefore not "keep as is" any more: they go to local too. Coordinator 20:31 CST Nov 13 (20:30): overlaps lane session_013NEJL2xbx9cwQLXuRSA66d (local-autonomy-equals-cloud) and PR #3323; coordinate through step notes only.
source: Consultant 20:20 CST Nov 13, from the owner's chat 20:16; unmeasured, since cloud sessions' local files are not readable from there.
